segment.source: B-WING The Alliance deploys the B-wing while searching for a new home.
segment.target: B翼戰機 同盟在尋找新家園的同時 部署B翼戰機。

segment.source:
After the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance Fleet had no choice but to abandon its main base. Pursued by Imperial forces, the Alliance survived treachery and starvation.
Now the search for a new base continues; as does the Emperor and Lord Vader's desire to destroy the Rebellion.
But the Alliance prepares to unleash a new weapon.. the B-wing Starfighter!
segment.target:
雅汶戰役之後，同盟艦隊別無選擇，只能放棄其主要基地。在帝國軍隊的追擊下，同盟挺過了背叛與飢荒。
如今，尋找新基地的行動仍在繼續；而皇帝與維達閣下摧毀起義革命的野心亦未曾停歇。
但同盟正準備釋放一款全新武器……B翼星際戰機！

segment.source: Protect a makeshift B-wing assembly area from an attack by Imperial scouting forces.
segment.target: 保護臨時搭建的 B翼戰機組裝區， 抵禦帝國偵察部隊的 突襲。
>第 1 號作戰：保護B翼戰機組裝區

segment.source: A number of B-wings are undergoing final preparations for duty.
segment.target: 多架B翼戰機正在進行最後的出擊準備整裝。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] will escort Freighter [[Niven]] to the area and start patrolling.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]將護航貨船[[尼文號（Niven）]]抵達該區域並展開警戒巡邏。

segment.source: Safeguard this installation by eliminating any enemy encountered.
segment.target: 消滅遭遇的所有敵軍，捍衛這座組裝設施。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] will be relieved when X-wing [[Gold]] returns with Freighter [[Purnel]].
segment.target: 當X翼[[金隊]]護送貨船[[珀內爾號（Purnel）]]返航時，將接替X翼[[紅隊]]的任務。

segment.source: X-wing [[Gold]] has been on patrol and will return in fifteen minutes.
segment.target: X翼[[金隊]]一直在外圍巡邏，將在十五分鐘後返航。

segment.source: Our ability to sustain this rebellion often relies on a readiness to improvise. A makeshift assembly area has been constructed with bulk cargo containers. It is being used to prepare a squadron of B-wings for duty.$ [[Red]] and[[ Gold]] Squadrons are taking turns escorting Freighters in and out of the area. You must ensure that the B-wings and the entire assembly area survives.
segment.target: 我們維持這場起義的能力往往仰賴靈機應變。一座臨時組裝區由大型貨櫃搭建而成，專門用於整裝一個中隊的B翼戰機投入服役。$ [[紅隊]]與[[金隊]]中隊正輪流護航貨船進出該區域。你必須確保所有B翼戰機及整座組裝區的絕對安全。

segment.source: Welcome back, we realize your leave was short. News of the destruction we caused with our attack on an Imperial Deep Dock is spreading throughout the galaxy, gaining new respect for the Alliance. The exploits of [[Red]] Squadron, especially, are becoming legendary.$ As you know, the Alliance continues to search for a location to build a new main base. Meanwhile we are preparing to deploy a new weapon...
segment.target: 歡迎歸隊，我們知道你的休假很短暫。我們突襲帝國深空船塢所造成的重創消息已傳遍整個銀河系，為同盟贏得了新的敬重。尤其是[[紅隊]]中隊的英勇事蹟，更已成為傳奇。$ 如你所知，同盟正持續尋找建立新主力基地的地點。與此同時，我們正準備部署一款全新武器……

segment.source: the [[Slayn & Korpil]] B-wing Heavy Assault Starfighter! Presumably, you are all spending time in the B-wing simulators. We're sure you can't wait to unleash that extra firepower on the Empire!$ B-wings are being produced as rapidly as possible. [[Blue]] Squadron aboard the Cruiser [[Maria]] is slated to receive the first full squadron of operational B-wings. With these we plan to resume offensive operations.
segment.target: 那就是[[斯萊恩與科皮爾公司（Slayn & Korpil）]]設計的B翼重型突擊星際戰機！想必你們都已在B翼模擬艙中花了不少時間。我們相信你們一定迫不及待想向帝國宣洩那強大的額外火力！$ B翼戰機目前正全速生產中。巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號（Maria）]]上的[[藍隊]]中隊預計將接收第一支成軍的B翼滿編中隊。我們打算藉此重啟全面進攻行動。

segment.source: Intercept and destroy GUN Mu (2 follow up waves.)$ Destroy nearest CRV with 6 torps.$ Attack GUN Rho while ordering wingmen to attack 2nd pair of CRVs. After 1st wave of GUN Rho is destroyed, finish off remaining CRV from 1st group with lasers.$ Destroy GUN Rho's 2 follow up waves, then assist wingmen to finish off second pair of CRVs.$ Don't allow GUNs to attack B-Ws!
segment.target: 攔截並摧毀突擊砲艇（GUN）繆隊（後續有 2 波增援）。$ 用 6 枚魚雷摧毀最近的巡邏艦（CRV）。$ 攻擊突擊砲艇羅隊，同時命令僚機攻擊第 2 組巡邏艦。在消滅第 1 波突擊砲艇羅隊後，用雷射解決第 1 組中殘存的巡邏艦。$ 消滅突擊砲艇羅隊的後續 2 波增援，然後協助僚機摧毀第 2 組巡邏艦。$ 絕不能讓突擊砲艇攻擊B翼戰機！

segment.source: GOLD ONE TO RED SQUADRON, WE'LL TAKE OVER NOW
segment.target: 金隊長呼叫紅隊中隊：接下來交給我們接手

segment.source: Ward off another attack by the Empire so that new B-wings may escape to safety.
segment.target: 擊退帝國的 另一波進攻， 掩護新型B翼戰機 安全撤離。
>第 2 號作戰：掩護組裝區撤離

segment.source: This B-wing assembly area has been discovered and must be evacuated.
segment.target: 這座B翼戰機組裝區已暴露，必須立即撤離。

segment.source: Ferry pilots will fly the B-wings into hyperspace as quickly as they're able.
segment.target: 轉場飛行員將盡快駕駛B翼戰機跳入超空間。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] will fend off any further Imperial attacks while we evacuate.
segment.target: 在我們撤離期間，X翼[[紅隊]]將擊退帝國的後續進攻。

segment.source: The last Imperial raid forces us to abandon this assembly area. The attack was witnessed by a race calling themselves the [[Habassa]].$ Preliminary communications with them are inconclusive, but we believe they intend to help us. We have explained that we are unable to evacuate the assembly area crew. They have generously offered to send a rescue ship and we have accepted.
segment.target: 帝國上一次的突襲迫使我們不得不放棄這座組裝區。自稱[[哈巴薩人（Habassa）]]的種族目睹了那場戰鬥。$ 與他們的初步通訊尚未有定論，但我們相信他們願意伸出援手。我們向他們說明我方無法撤離組裝區的工作人員。他們慷慨地表示願意派遣救援船，我們已經接受了這項提議。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will send a four ship group of fresh X-wings to cover the evacuation. Some of the station's crew are being given a crash course on the controls of the B-wing. Be aware that the ferry pilots are really Tug drivers. They are NOT combat trained! They will be relying on you.$ Fend off the inevitable Imperial attack until all of the B-wings and the assembly area's crew have been evacuated.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣四架全新整裝的X翼戰機掩護撤離行動。基地部分組員正在接受B翼戰機操控的應急速成培訓。請注意，這些轉場飛行員實際上只是拖船駕駛員，完全沒有受過戰鬥訓練！他們將完全仰賴你的保護。$ 堅決擊退帝國無可避免的進攻，直到所有B翼戰機與組裝區組員全數安全撤離為止。

segment.source: The [[Habassa]] have promised to send a ship to rescue the station crew.
segment.target: [[哈巴薩人]]已承諾派遣飛船前來營救基地組員。

segment.source: Take out the first wave of T/F Alpha ASAP, but watch for T/B Beta. Break off from Alpha and destroy Beta when the T/Bs are in range. Order your wingmen to keep after Alpha. Don't let anything slip by!$ Alpha, Beta and T/F Gamma all have seven follow up waves.$ Don't get too close to the STD. If it is attacked (or hit by a stray shot) T/B Delta will launch. Delta is a Top Ace group of 6 with 3 waves!
segment.target: 儘快消滅第 1 波鈦戰機（T/F）阿爾法隊，但務必警戒鈦式轟炸機（T/B）貝塔隊。一旦轟炸機進入射程，立即脫離阿爾法隊並消滅貝塔隊。命令僚機持續緊咬阿爾法隊。絕不能放漏任何敵機！$ 阿爾法、貝塔與鈦戰機伽瑪隊各自都有 7 波增援。$ 切勿過於接近滅星者（STD）。若滅星者遭到攻擊（或被流彈擊中），鈦式轟炸機德爾塔隊將會出擊。德爾塔隊是由 6 架頂尖王牌組成的隊伍，共有 3 波！

segment.source: THE B-WINGS HAVE MADE IT OUT
segment.target: B翼戰機已全數成功撤離

segment.source: THE STATION'S CREW HAS BEEN RESCUED
segment.target: 組裝站的組員已被成功營救

segment.source: Protect new B-wings as they rendezvous with their mother ship.
segment.target: 保護新型B翼戰機， 協助他們與 母艦順利會合。
>第 3 號作戰：保護B翼戰機交付

segment.source: A new squadron of B-wings is being deployed with the Cruiser [[Maria]].
segment.target: 一支全新的B翼戰機中隊正部署至巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號（Maria）]]。

segment.source: A pair of A-wings from[[ Red]] Squadron will escort them to their base ship.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊的一對A翼戰機將護航他們前往母艦。

segment.source: The B-wings are being delivered by ferry pilots untrained in combat.
segment.target: 這些B翼戰機由未受過戰鬥訓練的轉場飛行員駕駛。

segment.source: They must be protected from harm until they safely board the [[Maria]].
segment.target: 在安全登上[[瑪麗亞號]]之前，必須確保他們免受傷害。

segment.source: The B-wings you have protected are being deployed with the fleet. [[Blue]] Squadron aboard the Cruiser [[Maria]] is trading in their Y-wings for these new heavy assault fighters.$ [[Red]] Squadron will provide a pair of A-wings to escort these B-wings to their new base ship. Remember, the B-wings are being flown by ferry pilots, not combat aces, so don't let them come under attack! Then wait for the[[ Maria]] to enter hyperspace.
segment.target: 你們所保護的B翼戰機即將正式部署到艦隊中。巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號]]上的[[藍隊]]中隊正將他們的Y翼戰機換裝為這些全新重型突擊戰機。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣兩架A翼戰機護送這批B翼戰機前往新母艦。請記住，駕駛B翼的是轉場飛行員而非王牌老手，絕不能讓他們陷入敵火！隨後等待[[瑪麗亞號]]跳入超空間。

segment.source: Thanks to your efforts and the timely assistance of the [[Habassa]], we were able to evacuate the B-wings and the assembly area crew. The Alliance is now seeking to convince the [[Habassa]] to join the Rebellion.$ They have had almost no contact with the Empire and seem skeptical of our claims. Nonetheless, they remain willing to help us. Their extensive knowledge of this sector may reveal a suitable location for a new base.
segment.target: 多虧了你們的努力以及[[哈巴薩人]]的及時相助，我們才能成功撤離B翼戰機與組裝區人員。同盟目前正力圖說服[[哈巴薩人]]加入起義陣營。$ 他們此前幾乎未曾與帝國接觸，對我們的說法抱持懷疑。然而，他們依然願意提供協助。他們對本星區的深入了解，或許能為我們的新基地指引出理想地點。

segment.source: Intercept and destroy T/F Alpha 1-3 (and 3 follow up waves.) Ignore Alpha 4-6.$ FRG Metternich arrives on the destruction of T/B Beta. Intercept T/I Gamma (3 waves) and T/B Delta (3 waves).$ Gamma targets the B-Ws and you, Delta attacks the CRS Maria.$ GUN Tau (3 waves) arrives on the destruction of T/B Delta.
segment.target: 攔截並摧毀鈦戰機（T/F）阿爾法 1-3 號（後續有 3 波增援）。忽略阿爾法 4-6 號。$ 巡防艦梅特涅號將在鈦式轟炸機（T/B）貝塔隊被摧毀時抵達。攔截鈦式截擊機（T/I）伽瑪隊（3 波）與鈦式轟炸機德爾塔隊（3 波）。$ 伽瑪隊的目標是B翼戰機與你，德爾塔隊則攻擊巡洋艦瑪麗亞號。$ 突擊砲艇陶隊（3 波）將在鈦式轟炸機德爾塔隊被摧毀時進場。

segment.target: B翼戰機已安全降落登上瑪麗亞號

segment.source: THE MARIA TOOK SOME HITS BUT MADE IT TO SAFETY
segment.target: 瑪麗亞號雖遭受若干砲火，但已成功脫險

segment.source: Destroy an Imperial TIE Fighter Staging Area in your first B-wing Tour of Duty mission.
segment.target: 駕駛你的B翼戰機， 執行首趟巡弋服役任務， 摧毀帝國鈦戰機 集結區。
>第 4 號作戰：摧毀鈦戰機集結區

segment.source: B-wing [[Red One]] will be assaulting an Imperial TIE Fighter staging area.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊長]]將對帝國鈦戰機集結區發動突襲。

segment.source: Watch out for enemy patrols and TIE Fighters escaping from Containers.
segment.target: 警戒敵方巡邏隊以及從貨櫃中緊急出動的鈦戰機。

segment.source: All of the Containers that make up this facility must be destroyed.
segment.target: 構成該設施的所有貨櫃都必須全數摧毀。

segment.source: As you are aware, we are inflicting heavy losses to the starfighter complements of the Imperial capital ships we have battled. The Empire's response is to establish TIE Fighter staging areas in occupied systems. This way Imperial starships may be kept closer to where they are needed, and losses can be replaced as quickly as possible. To interdict the flow of replacements we are going to attack these staging areas.
segment.target: 如你所知，在與我們交戰的帝國主力艦艇中，其艦載星際戰機編隊遭受了沉重打擊。帝國的對策是在佔領星系建立鈦戰機集結區。這樣一來，帝國星艦便能常駐於任務前線，並在戰損時以最快速度獲得補充。為了阻斷帝國戰機的補給線，我們將主動摧毀這些集結區。

segment.source: A single B-wing from [[Red]] Squadron will be sent to attack the staging area near [[Yunkor IX]]. The facility is actually made up of a number of Cargo Containers. These have been set up as hangars and work areas.$ Two proton torpedoes will knock down a Container's shields. A third is guaranteed to destroy it, so the B-wing's load of twelve should be sufficient! Be sure to destroy any TIE Fighters parked in the area.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣單架B翼戰機突襲位於[[雲科爾九號（Yunkor IX）]]附近的集結區。該設施實際上是由數個貨運貨櫃組合而成，被改裝為機庫與維修作業區。$ 兩枚質子魚雷即可擊破貨櫃的護盾，第三枚足以確保將其徹底炸毀，因此B翼戰機掛載的十二枚魚雷綽綽有餘！務必摧毀停放在該區域的所有鈦戰機。

segment.source: Destroy any TIE Fighters parked nearby as well.
segment.target: 停放在附近的任何鈦戰機也必須一併摧毀。

segment.source: Destroy 2 of GUN Nu at start. (Destruction of 3rd will trigger the arrival of a tougher group.)$ A B-W's shields can easily handle fire from one GUN, so ignore it! Concentrate on destroying the CONs. Destroy them one at a time, using 3 torps on each. Torps alone will take out all but one. Laser the last CON.$ The B-wing is an excellent minesweeper, but don't even worry about the mines in this mission.
segment.target: 開局先摧毀突擊砲艇紐隊中的 2 架。（摧毀第 3 架會觸發更強敵軍增援抵達。）$ B翼戰機的強大護盾能輕鬆承受單架砲艇的火力，因此暫且不理它！集中全力摧毀貨櫃（CON）。每次專注摧毀一個，對每個貨櫃發射 3 枚魚雷。單靠魚雷就能解決除最後一個以外的所有貨櫃。最後一個貨櫃用雷射解決。$ B翼戰機是極佳的掃雷機，但本次任務中甚至不必理會水雷。

segment.source: THOSE TIE FIGHTERS WON'T BE SEEING ANY ACTION!
segment.target: 那些鈦戰機休想再踏上戰場！

segment.source: GOOD JOB, RED ONE. HEAD HOME.
segment.target: 幹得漂亮，紅隊長。返航基地。

segment.source: Wipe out an Imperial Secret Weapons Research Base that is attempting to recreate the super shield technology.
segment.target: 摧毀企圖重現 超級護盾技術的 帝國機密武器 研發基地。
>第 5 號作戰：摧毀機密武器基地

segment.source: A hidden Imperial Secret Weapons Research Base has been discovered.
segment.target: 一座隱蔽的帝國機密武器研發基地已被發現。

segment.source: Four handpicked pilots will fly one of each type of Alliance starfighter.
segment.target: 四名精選的飛行員將分別駕駛同盟的四種星際戰機出擊。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] [[One]] will be escorted by A-wing [[Red Two]] during the attack.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊長]]將在突擊中由A翼[[紅二號]]護航。

segment.source: Y-wing [[Gold One]] will be escorted by X-wing [[Gold Two]] during the attack.
segment.target: Y翼[[金隊長]]將在突擊中由X翼[[金二號]]護航。

segment.source: Our latest information says it is only protected by two Corvettes.
segment.target: 最新情報顯示，該處僅有兩艘巡邏艦防衛。

segment.source: Alliance Intelligence has discovered a hidden Imperial Secret Weapons Research Base. We believe it is attempting to recreate the same super shield technology that we stole for Operation [[Ram's Head]]. This must not be allowed to happen.$ The target is a small facility constructed with Cargo Containers so as to appear unimportant. Fortuitously, it is defended only by a pair of Corvettes.
segment.target: 同盟情報部發現了一座隱密的帝國機密武器研發基地。我們研判他們正企圖重現我們在「[[公羊角]]」作戰中奪取的超級護盾技術。我們絕不能讓這種事發生。$ 目標是一座由貨櫃偽裝搭建的小型設施，看起來微不足道。幸運的是，防禦僅有兩艘巡邏艦。

segment.source: The entire facility must be destroyed.
segment.target: 整座設施必須徹底摧毀。

segment.source: Because of the light defenses, we plan to use this raid to illustrate the advances made in starfighter design. Specifically, one of each Alliance starfighter type will be used. They will attack in two pairs to allow a comparison of their tactical effectiveness.$ An A-wing/B-wing team will be sent by [[Red]] Squadron, while [[Gold]] Squadron will supply the traditional X-wing/Y-wing team.
segment.target: 鑑於敵方防禦薄弱，我們計畫利用此次突擊展示戰機設計上的突破。具體來說，同盟的每一款主力戰機都將參戰。他們將分成兩組雙機編組出擊，以評估其戰術作戰效能。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派出A翼/B翼搭檔，而[[金隊]]中隊則提供傳統的X翼/Y翼搭檔。

segment.source: Scroll through target list to 2nd CRV and fire 6 torps at it. Target 1st CRV and fire 4 torps at it, then switch to ions and disable it.$ Switch back to lasers and destroy the CONs. Engage the T/Bs if necessary, but avoid if you can.$ Two more CRVs and GUN Mu (3 ships) will enter 12 seconds after the destruction of the 1st CRV, so destroy it last.$
segment.target: 在目標清單中切換至第 2 艘巡邏艦（CRV），向其發射 6 枚魚雷。鎖定第 1 艘巡邏艦並發射 4 枚魚雷，然後切換至離子砲將其癱瘓。$ 切換回雷射並摧毀貨櫃（CON）。若有必要可與鈦式轟炸機（T/B）交火，但能避開就避開。$ 在第 1 艘巡邏艦被摧毀 12 秒後，將有另外兩艘巡邏艦與突擊砲艇繆隊（3 架）進入，因此最後再摧毀它。$

segment.source: THIS IMPERIAL SECRET WEAPONS RESEARCH BASE HAS BEEN DESTROYED
segment.target: 這座帝國機密武器研發基地已被徹底摧毀

segment.source: Lead a rescue mission to free Habassan prisoners from an Imperial slave labor convoy.
segment.target: 率領救援任務， 從帝國奴隸勞工船隊中 解救哈巴薩人 戰俘。
>第 6 號作戰：營救戰俘行動

segment.source: [[Habassan]] prisoners are being transported in Imperial Freighters.
segment.target: [[哈巴薩]]戰俘正由帝國貨船載運轉移。

segment.source: [[Red One]] will identify and disable any Freighters with [[Habassan]] prisoners.
segment.target: [[紅隊長]]將識別並癱瘓任何載有[[哈巴薩]]戰俘的貨船。

segment.source: An A-wing from [[Blue]] Squadron will provide escort for Y-wing [[Red One]].
segment.target: [[藍隊]]中隊的一架A翼戰機將為Y翼[[紅隊長]]提供護航。

segment.source: Once disabled, Transport [[Ranger]] will arrive to board and rescue.
segment.target: 一旦目標被癱瘓，運輸艦[[遊俠號（Ranger）]]將抵達並登艦營救。

segment.source: Our envoy to the [[Habassa]] continues to press for their entry into the Alliance. They remain skeptical, unable or unwilling to recognize the threat of the Empire.$ Intelligence has uncovered a cargo manifest for an Imperial convoy. Among the prisoners destined for slave labor are a number of [[Habassans]]. It is clear that if the [[Habassan]] leadership were aware of this their attitude would change!
segment.target: 我們派往[[哈巴薩人]]的特使仍在極力爭取他們加入同盟。他們依然抱持懷疑態度，無法或不願認清帝國的殘暴本質。$ 情報部截獲了一份帝國船隊的載貨清單。在預計送往奴隸營的囚犯中，包括許多[[哈巴薩人]]。顯然，只要[[哈巴薩]]領導層獲悉此事，他們的態度必將迎刃而解！

segment.source: The convoy is due to rendezvous with the Frigate [[Mayhem]] near [[Cificap VIII]]. An Alliance Special Operations unit has arranged a delay for the Frigate. This will allow us the opportunity to hit the convoy and rescue the [[Habassan]] prisoners.$ The rescue team will consist of a Y-wing from [[Red]] Squadron, Transport [[Ranger]] from Special Ops. and an A-wing from [[Blue ]]Squadron.
segment.target: 該船隊預計在[[塞菲卡普八號（Cificap VIII）]]附近與巡防艦[[混亂號（Mayhem）]]會合。同盟特種作戰部隊已設計拖延該巡防艦的抵達時間。這將為我們創造突擊船隊並營救[[哈巴薩]]戰俘的良機。$ 救援小隊將由[[紅隊]]中隊的一架Y翼戰機、特戰部隊的運輸艦[[遊俠號]]以及[[藍隊]]中隊的一架A翼戰機組成。

segment.source: The Frigate [[Mayhem]] is en route and will arrive soon so be quick!
segment.target: 巡防艦[[混亂號]]已在途中且隨時可能抵達，動作務必迅速！

segment.source: Destroy all 3 SHUs first. (The 'R' key won't help you.)$ ID all FRTs. Destroy any trailing FRT(s) without prisoners before disabling the special FRT. The prisoner FRT will be either the 1st or the 2nd.$ A FRG enters when the prisoner FRT is disabled, so fully charge shields and lasers before disabling.$ Intercept and destroy all fighters launched by FRG, especially the T/Bs.
segment.target: 首先摧毀所有 3 架太空梭（SHU）。（『R』鍵幫不了你。）$ 辨識所有貨船（FRT）。在癱瘓特殊貨船前，先摧毀任何沒有戰俘的尾隨貨船。載運戰俘的貨船通常是第 1 艘或第 2 艘。$ 當戰俘貨船被癱瘓時巡防艦將會進場，因此在癱瘓前務必將護盾與雷射充滿能量。$ 攔截並摧毀巡防艦放出的所有戰機，特別是鈦式轟炸機（T/B）。

segment.source: THIS WILL REPAY THE HABASSA FOR THEIR HELP
segment.target: 這足以報答哈巴薩人的鼎力相助

segment.source: PERHAPS IT WILL CONVINCE THEM TO JOIN THE ALLIANCE
segment.target: 或許這能說服他們正式加入同盟

segment.source: Scramble to assist an Habassan convoy out of an Imperial ambush so that they may be convinced to join the Alliance.
segment.target: 緊急出動， 協助哈巴薩船隊 脫離帝國伏擊， 爭取他們加入同盟。
>第 7 號作戰：協助中立勢力脫困

segment.source: An [[Habassan]] convoy is to be ambushed by Corvettes near [[Retep V]].
segment.target: 一隊哈巴薩船團遭到帝國軍隊伏擊！

segment.source: All nearby Alliance starfighters will scramble to intercept the Imperials.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]必須迅速出動，保護他們脫離險境。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will send four X-wings with two A-wings from [[Gold]] Squadron.
segment.target: 只要這支船團能倖存，定能促使哈巴薩人加入同盟。

segment.source: Additionally, [[Blue]] Squadron will send three B-wings within six minutes.
segment.target: 哈巴薩船團由三艘貨船與兩艘運輸艦組成。

segment.source: Quickly intercept and destroy all of the attacking Imperial ships.
segment.target: 哈巴薩政府對加入同盟的提議一直猶豫不決。他們對帝國威脅的態度依然曖昧。$ 現在情勢急轉直下，一支哈巴薩船團在[[雷特普五號（Retep V）]]附近遭到帝國軍隊伏擊！如果我們能及時趕到並拯救他們，哈巴薩人勢必會看清帝國的真面目並加入同盟！

segment.source: Save as much of the convoy as possible.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊將緊急出動三架X翼戰機，前往救援哈巴薩船團。現場將遭到大量帝國星際戰機的圍攻，因此務必保持高度警惕。$ 確保盡可能多的哈巴薩艦船生還，並掩護他們進入超空間脫離戰場。

segment.source: Alliance Intelligence has intercepted plans for an Imperial ambush of an [[Habassan]] convoy. The attack will be conducted by a pair of Corvettes.$ We have alerted the [[Habassa]] and they are scrambling their meager forces. As a further demonstration of Alliance resolve all available starfighters are to aid the attempted interception. The outcome of this mission may decide the [[Habassans']] allegiance. Do your best!
segment.target: 同盟情報部截獲了帝國伏擊[[哈巴薩]]船團的作戰計畫。攻擊將由兩艘巡邏艦發起。$ 我們已向[[哈巴薩人]]發出預警，他們正在緊急調動其有限的防衛力量。為了進一步展現同盟的決心，所有待命的星際戰機都必須前往支援攔截。這次任務的結果很可能決定[[哈巴薩人]]的效忠歸屬。全力以赴！

segment.source: The [[Habassa]] are an isolationist culture. Their home system is remote from Imperial concerns and their desire to remain neutral is strong. There are some among the [[Habassa]] who recognize the threat of the Empire. They realize it is only a matter of time before the Emperor's heavy hand is laid upon them.$ With the return of the captured [[Habassans]] the case for remaining neutral is further weakened.
segment.target: 全速飛向船團。優先消滅鈦式轟炸機（T/B）貝塔隊與伽瑪隊。$ 命令僚機攻擊鈦戰機（T/F）阿爾法隊，避免他們干擾你的攔截。$ 保留足夠魚雷以應對隨後進場的帝國突擊砲艇。只要船團艦船跳入超空間即可完成任務。

segment.source: Get to the CRVs ASAP, but don't use your torps. Save them for the FRG that enters when the CRVs die.$ Order your wingmen to attack the FRG, use all of your torpedoes.$ Attack T/A Eta, but break off as soon as T/B Alpha launches.$ Intercept T/B Alpha and all nine waves as quickly as you can. Order your wingmen to assist.$ Destroy TRN Upsilon to trigger arrival of Habassan Y-wings for help.
segment.target: 儘快趕到巡邏艦（CRV）處，但先別用魚雷。把魚雷留給巡邏艦被摧毀後進場的巡防艦（FRG）。$ 命令僚機攻擊巡防艦，將所有魚雷全數傾瀉在它身上。$ 交戰進階型鈦戰機（T/A）艾塔隊，但一旦鈦式轟炸機（T/B）阿爾法隊升空就立刻脫離轉向。$ 儘快攔截鈦式轟炸機阿爾法隊及其全部九波增援。命令僚機協助。$ 摧毀運輸艦（TRN）宇普西隆隊可觸發哈巴薩Y翼戰機前來支援。

segment.source: MOST OF THE CONVOY HAS ESCAPED
segment.target: 哈巴薩船隊已安全脫險

segment.source: THE HABASSA HAVE ALREADY EXPRESSED THEIR GRATITUDE

segment.target: 這肯定能促使他們正式加入同盟
護送要員前往同盟巡洋艦

segment.source: Escort Habassan Envoy to the Alliance flagship for a formal declaration of allegiance to the Rebellion.
segment.target: 護送哈巴薩特使 前往同盟旗艦， 以正式宣布 對起義軍效忠。
>第 8 號作戰：護送要員前往旗艦

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will escort the [[Habassan]] envoy to the Cruiser [[Independence]].
segment.target: 哈巴薩特使正搭乘運輸艦[[巴迪克托爾號（Bardictol）]]前來。

segment.source: Thanks to the timely intervention of Alliance forces, most of the [[Habassan]] convoy was saved. Now the [[Habassa]] have agreed to join the Rebellion. All that remains is a formal declaration aboard the Alliance flagship, the Cruiser [[Independence]].$ Security is being kept very tight because the Empire has stepped up efforts to track our movements. Surveillance probes seem to be turning up everywhere.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將護送特使前往巡洋艦[[獨立號（Independence）]]。

segment.source: The safety of the [[Habassa]] is paramount, they must be protected!
segment.target: 特使將在此正式宣布哈巴薩人效忠反抗軍同盟。

segment.source: The [[Habassan]] envoy has requested that [[Red]] Squadron be assigned the task of escorting their transport to the [[Independence]]. They have gained a great deal of respect for the warriors of the Alliance, especially the pilots of [[Red]] Squadron.$ Three A-wings are to be sent to rendezvous with the [[Habassan]] Transport [[Bardictol]]. Our formal alliance with them will fall through if any harm comes to this delegation.
segment.target: 我們在伏擊戰中的英勇救援徹底扭轉了哈巴薩人的立場。哈巴薩領導層已決定正式與同盟結盟！特使正前往同盟旗艦[[獨立號]]簽署盟約。$ 這對同盟來說是重大的政治與軍事勝利。我們絕不能讓帝國有任何破壞這次會晤的機會。

segment.source: Attack T/I Eta and Theta in passing, but don't get caught up dogfighting them. They will harass you, but you should ignore them.$ Intercept and destroy T/F groups Alpha and Beta. They target TRN Bardictol, and each group has three follow up waves.$ Destroy T/Bs with missiles as the opportunities arise, but concentrate on the T/Fs.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣兩架A翼戰機擔任護送前鋒。預計帝國會派遣攔截機與突擊砲艇進行破壞。保護特使運輸艦的絕對安全！

segment.source: THE HABASSAN ENVOY IS SAFE ABOARD THE INDEPENDENCE
segment.target: 特使已安全登上獨立號
哈巴薩人現已正式成為反抗軍同盟的一員！

segment.source: Guard Alliance Freighters as they pickup foodstuffs delivered by the Habassa.
segment.target: 掩護同盟貨船 收取由哈巴薩人 交付的 食品物資。
>第 9 號作戰：守護貨物收取作業

segment.source: [[Habassan]] Freighters will deliver a cargo of foodstuffs near [[Retep III]].
segment.target: 哈巴薩人已送來大批急需的食品與物資貨櫃。

segment.source: Two Alliance Freighters will come in to pick up the cargo.
segment.target: 兩艘同盟貨船將前往收取這批重要補給。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will escort the Alliance Freighters and protect the transfer.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將在轉運期間提供全程空中掩護。

segment.source: The [[Habassa]] have joined the Alliance, but they wish this to be kept secret. They hope to lessen the Empire's ill will by appearing steadfastly neutral. We have agreed to this because it is obvious that the Imperial Navy is monitoring their system closely through a network of surveillance probes.$ This network is now being studied. We must disrupt it if we are to keep our fleet operations hidden.
segment.target: 提防帝國巡防艦及星際戰機的突襲！

segment.source: The [[Habassa]] will deliver cargo containers full of foodstuffs to the [[Retep III]] system. Two Alliance Freighters will rendezvous there to pick up the shipment. The cargo transfer will take about [[six]] minutes.$ [[Red]] Squadron will send a pair of A-wings to escort the Freighters. This shipment is badly needed so the operation must be protected from Imperial attack.
segment.target: 作為盟約的實質回報，[[哈巴薩人]]向[[雷特普三號（Retep III）]]星系運送了滿載食品的貨櫃。兩艘同盟貨船將前往該處進行會合並接收物資。轉運作業大約需要[[六]]分鐘。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派出兩架A翼戰機護航貨船。這批物資是全軍急需的口糧，必須確保轉運作業免遭帝國破壞。

segment.source: Watch for entry of FRG Anjisan. Intercept and destroy all T/Bs, (there are 20).$ Attack T/As in passing, but concentrate on T/Bs.$$$$>SPOILER!$$ [[ Destroy distant CON. Many allied craft will arrive to destroy FRG.]]
segment.target: 警戒帝國巡防艦安吉桑號（Anjisan）的進場。攔截並消滅所有鈦式轟炸機（共 20 架）。$ 在掠過時攻擊進階型鈦戰機，但首要精力放在鈦式轟炸機上。$$$$>劇透提示！$$ [[ 摧毀遠處的貨櫃，將有大量盟軍艦艇抵達協助摧毀巡防艦。]]

segment.source: THE EMPIRE MUST HAVE BEEN TIPPED OFF
segment.target: 帝國一定是事先收到了風聲

segment.source: STILL, WE STOPPED THEIR ATTACK. GOOD WORK, RED ONE!
segment.target: 但我們依然成功阻截了他們的進攻。幹得好，紅隊長！

segment.source: Lead a raid to capture an Imperial Freighter loaded with surveillance probes.
segment.target: 率領突擊隊， 俘獲一艘裝載 偵察探測器的 帝國貨船。
>第 10 號作戰：俘獲探測器貨船

segment.source: The Empire is deploying surveillance probes in all outer systems.
segment.target: 帝國正向所有外圍星系密集部署偵察探測器。

segment.source: The probes for this sector are distributed from this transfer area.
segment.target: 該星區的探測器全部由這座轉運區域分發發送。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will lead the raid to capture a loaded Freighter.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將帶頭突襲，俘獲一艘滿載探測器的貨船。

segment.source: The area is protected by Assault Gunboats and a small minefield.
segment.target: 該區域由突擊砲艇以及小型雷區提供防禦。

segment.source: A-wing [[Gold]] will provide escort and keep the Gunboats busy.
segment.target: A翼[[金隊]]將提供護航，牽制並消滅突擊砲艇。

segment.source: [[Storm Unit's]] commandos will capture the disabled Freighter.
segment.target: [[風暴小隊]]的特戰突擊隊將強行登艦俘獲被癱瘓的貨船。

segment.source: Close study of the Imperial Navy's surveillance network has suggested a plan. Intelligence has determined that the probe's data is being coordinated through the Imperial Star Destroyer [[Relentless]]. [[Darth Vader]] has charged the commander of the [[Relentless]] with fixing the location of the Alliance Fleet. Once this is accomplished, the full weight of the Imperial Navy will be brought to bear.
segment.target: 對帝國海軍偵察網絡的深入研究讓我們制定了一項大膽計策。情報顯示，探測器的數據正透過帝國滅星者[[殘酷號（Relentless）]]進行統一協調。[[達斯維達]]親自命令[[殘酷號]]指揮官限期查明同盟艦隊的確切位置。一旦位置暴露，帝國海軍的主力艦隊將全力撲來。

segment.source: Probes for this sector are being distributed out of the Imperial Cargo Transfer Area near [[Bofa II]]. The Freighter [[Libom]] is on its way there with a load of new probes.$ [[Red]] Squadron will send one B-wing to identify and disable the Freighter when it arrives. [[Storm Unit]] will then capture it, and the probes will be altered to report false information. These will be substituted to disguise our fleet movements from the Empire.
segment.target: 該星區的探測器正由位於[[波法二號（Bofa II）]]附近的帝國貨物轉運區分發。貨船[[利博姆號（Libom）]]正滿載一批全新探測器前往該處。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣一架B翼戰機在該貨船抵達時將其識別並癱瘓。隨後[[風暴小隊]]將實施俘獲，我們的技術人員將竄改探測器代碼使其回傳假情報，以此掩護我方艦隊的動向。

segment.source: Destroy GUN Rho and its 2 waves.$ Order your escorts to wait outside the range of the mines. ID the FRTs. This will trigger the arrival of 2 CRVs (which must be destroyed), and 3.5 minutes later, the FRT Libom.$ Destroy the other FRTs (for points) and the minefield.$ ID and disable FRT Libom. TRN Storm Unit, an enemy CRV and FRG will arrive. Destroy CRV then intercept T/Bs coming from the FRG.
segment.target: 摧毀突擊砲艇羅隊及其後續 2 波。$ 命令護航僚機在雷區射程外待命。識別貨船（FRT），這將觸發 2 艘巡邏艦（CRV，必須摧毀）以及 3.5 分鐘後的貨船利博姆號。$ 摧毀其他貨船（賺取積分）並清除雷區。$ 識別並癱瘓貨船利博姆號。風暴小隊運輸艦、一艘敵方巡邏艦與巡防艦將會抵達。先摧毀巡邏艦，然後攔截來自巡防艦的鈦式轟炸機。

segment.source: STORM UNIT HAS CAPTURED THE FREIGHTER
segment.target: 風暴小隊已成功俘獲貨船

segment.source: OUR TECHS WILL MODIFY THE CAPTURED PROBES
segment.target: 我方技術人員將著手改裝繳獲的探測器

segment.source: Attack and destroy an Imperial System Patrol Squadron Base to frustrate Imperial reconnaissance.
segment.target: 攻擊並摧毀 帝國星系巡邏中隊基地， 挫敗帝國的 偵察網絡。
>第 11A 號作戰：摧毀巡邏艦基地

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] is to attack and destroy this Imperial Corvette Base.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將攻擊並徹底摧毀這座帝國巡邏艦基地。

segment.source: The base is protected by a minefield and a small number of TIEs.
segment.target: 基地由雷區以及少量鈦戰機駐防保護。

segment.source: The entire base and all of its Corvettes must be destroyed.
segment.target: 整座基地及其所有巡邏艦都必須徹底摧毀。

segment.source: High Command has determined that deceiving the Empire's surveillance network is only part of the solution. Large numbers of Corvettes and Assault Gunboats are conducting reconnaissance. These must be neutralized as well. They can not be altered like the probes, but they can be destroyed!$ If we can eliminate enough of them it will force the Empire to rely almost entirely on the altered probes.
segment.target: 最高統帥部判定，僅竄改帝國偵察網絡只是解決方案的一部分。大量巡邏艦與突擊砲艇仍在主動進行肉眼與雷達偵察。這些威脅也必須徹底消除。它們無法像探測器那樣被竄改，但可以被摧毀！$ 只要消滅足夠數量的巡邏艦，就能迫使帝國幾乎完全依賴已被我們竄改的探測器。

segment.source: Every System Patrol Squadron base in this sector has been targeted for destruction. The base in the [[Farfeld]] system will be one of the toughest, so [[Red]] Squadron has been chosen to take it out.$ Three B-wings will be sufficient. Do not allow any of the Corvettes to escape. Be sure to wipe out the entire facility.
segment.target: 本星區內的所有星系巡邏中隊基地均已被列為摧毀目標。位於[[法費爾德（Farfeld）]]星系的基地防禦最為堅固，因此指派[[紅隊]]中隊前往拔除。$ 三架B翼戰機足以勝任。切勿讓任何巡邏艦逃脫。務必將整座設施化為灰燼。

segment.source: Destroy CRVs with torps ASAP (2nd CRV in target list 1st.)$ Order wingmen to attack T/F Alpha while you clear the minefield.$ 3rd CRV enters on destruction of 2nd CRV. GUN Tau enters on destruction of T/F Alpha. FRG Dark Eye enters 2 minutes after 1st CRV is destroyed.$>SPOILER!$[[ Destroy TUG to trigger arrival of neutral FRG and Y-Ws for assistance.]]
segment.target: 儘快用魚雷消滅巡邏艦（先鎖定目標清單中的第 2 艘巡邏艦）。$ 命令僚機攻擊鈦戰機阿爾法隊，同時你清理雷區。$ 第 3 艘巡邏艦在第 2 艘被摧毀時進入。突擊砲艇陶隊在鈦戰機阿爾法隊被摧毀時進入。巡防艦黑眼號將在第 1 艘巡邏艦被摧毀 2 分鐘後進入。$>劇透提示！$[[ 摧毀拖船（TUG）可觸發中立巡防艦與Y翼戰機前來支援。]]

segment.target: 攻擊並摧毀 帝國星系巡邏中隊基地， 挫敗帝國的 偵察網絡。
>第 11B 號作戰：摧毀帝國基地

segment.source: The [[Feenicks]] System Patrol Squadron Base is to be completely destroyed.
segment.target: 位於[[菲尼克斯（Feenicks）]]的星系巡邏中隊基地必須徹底摧毀。

segment.source: There will also be a small minefield to contend with.
segment.target: 現場還佈設了小型雷區需要清理。

segment.source: All [[Assassin]] class Corvettes must be eliminated.
segment.target: 所有[[暗殺者級（Assassin）]]巡邏艦都必須全數消滅。

segment.source: You may expect interference from Gunboats and a few TIE Bombers.
segment.target: 預計會遭遇突擊砲艇與若干鈦式轟炸機的強烈干擾。

segment.source: Two B-wings from [[Red]] Squadron will carry out this attack.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊的兩架B翼戰機將執行此次突擊。

segment.source: One X-wing from [[Blue]] Squadron will provide escort for the B-wings.
segment.target: [[藍隊]]中隊的一架X翼戰機將為B翼戰機提供護航。

segment.source: High Command has determined that deceiving the Empire's surveillance network is only part of the solution. Large numbers of Corvettes and Assault Gunboats are conducting reconnaissance. These can not be altered like the probes, but they can be destroyed!$ All System Patrol Squadron bases in this sector are to be hit. This will force the Empire to rely almost entirely on the altered probes.
segment.target: 最高統帥部判定，竄改帝國偵察網絡只是第一步。大量巡邏艦與突擊砲艇仍在四處巡弋。這些實體艦艇必須被徹底消滅！$ 本星區內的所有星系巡邏中隊基地都將遭到打擊。這將迫使帝國完全依賴我們偽造的探測器數據。

segment.source: The Imperial base in the [[Feenicks]] system will be taken out by a strike team of two B-wings and one X-wing. These outposts serve as small bases for System Patrol Squadrons of Assault Gunboats and Corvettes.$ This base in particular is home to an elite squadron equipped with Assassin class Corvettes. These Corvettes carry as many as four TIE Fighters or Bombers. Destroy all Corvettes and the base.
segment.target: 位於[[菲尼克斯]]星系的帝國基地將由兩架B翼與一架X翼組成的突擊隊負責拔除。這些前哨站是突擊砲艇與巡邏艦的基地。$ 特別是該基地駐紮了一支配備暗殺者級巡邏艦的精銳中隊。這些巡邏艦每艘可搭載多達四架鈦戰機或轟炸機。消滅所有巡邏艦與基地本體。

segment.source: Destroy at least one GUN on the way to the CONs. Your escort will keep at least one occupied.$ Order your wingman to attack the 1st CRV while you attack the next. Use 6 torps to kill it quickly, then destroy the 3rd in the same manner.$ Finish off the first with lasers, (blindside it if you can.) You may wish to clear the 6 mines first, though.
segment.target: 在前往貨櫃途中至少摧毀一架突擊砲艇（GUN）。你的護航機會牽制住至少一架。$ 命令僚機攻擊第 1 艘巡邏艦，你自己攻擊下一艘。用 6 枚魚雷迅速擊毀它，然後以同樣方式消滅第 3 艘。$ 用雷射解決第 1 艘（若可以的話從死角切入）。你也可以先清理周圍的 6 枚水雷。
報銷一座帝國前哨基地！

segment.source: Scramble to intercept another attack by the Empire on an Habassan convoy.
segment.target: 緊急出動， 攔截帝國對 哈巴薩船隊的 另一次攻擊。
>第 12 號作戰：攔截帝國突襲

segment.source: A distress call has been received from an [[Habassan]] convoy near [[Pii II]].
segment.target: 收到來自[[皮伊二號（Pii II）]]附近一支配備哈巴薩船隊的求救信號。

segment.source: They are under attack by Imperial forces and are requesting help.
segment.target: 他們正遭到帝國軍隊的猛烈攻擊並請求緊急支援。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] is all that is available to stop the Gunboats from their attack.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]是目前唯一能出動阻止突擊砲艇進攻的部隊。

segment.source: Despite their best attempts to appear neutral, the [[Habassa ]]are once again the victims of an attack by Imperial forces. A distress signal was just received from one of their convoys in the [[Pii]] system.$ Their report says they are under attack by an entire squadron of Assault Gunboats. Four B-wings from [[Red ]]Squadron are all that are available. Your ships are prepped, report to the hangar immediately!
segment.target: 儘管[[哈巴薩人]]極力保持中立外表，卻再度淪為帝國暴行的受害者。我們剛收到一封來自[[皮伊]]星系船團的求救信號。$ 報告指出他們遭到一整隊突擊砲艇的圍攻。[[紅隊]]中隊的四架B翼戰機是目前唯一待命的戰力。戰機已整裝完畢，立即前往機棚出擊！

segment.source: Attack GUNs Rho and Tau. You may wish to use torps to force them into evasive maneuvers, but save at least 6 for later.$ When FRT Jess 6 is disabled an Imperial FRT comes in to board & capture. You must stop it.$ When the Imperial FRT is destroyed 3 TRNs arrive to destroy Jess 6. Intercept and destroy these immediately! Use your remaining torps in dual-fire mode.
segment.target: 攻擊突擊砲艇羅隊與陶隊。你可以使用魚雷迫使他們進行規避，但請至少保留 6 枚魚雷備用。$ 當貨船傑斯 6 號被癱瘓時，將有一艘帝國貨船前來接舷俘獲。你必須予以阻止。$ 當帝國貨船被摧毀後，將有 3 艘運輸艦抵達企圖摧毀傑斯 6 號。立即攔截並消滅它們！以雙發模式使用剩餘的魚雷。

segment.source: YOU HAVE HELPED SAVE THE HABASSAN CONVOY
segment.target: 你成功協助拯救了哈巴薩船隊

segment.source: WE CAN EXPECT CLOSER RELATIONS WITH OUR NEW ALLIES
segment.target: 我們與新盟友的關係必將更加緊密

segment.source: KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK, RED FOUR!
Protect an Alliance Freighter as it delivers new B-wings to the Cruiser Cathleen.
segment.target: 保護同盟貨船， 將新型B翼戰機 安全運交 凱瑟琳號巡洋艦。
>第 13 號作戰：保護B翼戰機交付

segment.source: The Cruiser [[Cathleen]] is the next to receive a B-wing squadron. The Freighter [[Radley]] is carrying the new B-wings that are to be delivered to the Cruiser.$ The [[Radley]] is being guarded by A-wing [[Blue 5]]. [[Blue 5]] reported a shield system failure and has requested immediate withdrawal. [[Red]] Squadron will send a pair of A-wings ASAP. The [[Cathleen]] should arrive about ten minutes after you.
segment.target: 巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號（Cathleen）]]是下一艘接收B翼戰機中隊的主力艦。貨船[[拉德利號（Radley）]]載運著即將交付巡洋艦的新型B翼戰機。$ [[拉德利號]]由A翼[[藍隊 5 號]]負責護衛。[[藍隊 5 號]]回報護盾系統故障，請求立即撤退。[[紅隊]]中隊將儘快派遣一對A翼戰機接替。[[凱瑟琳號]]預計在你們抵達約十分鐘後到達。

segment.source: The Alliance Freighter [[Radley]] awaits a rendezvous with the Cruiser [[Cathleen]].
segment.target: 同盟貨船[[拉德利號]]正等待與巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]會合。

segment.source: The Cruiser [[Cathleen]] should arrive approximately ten minutes later.
segment.target: 巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]大約將在十分鐘後抵達。

segment.source: A-wing [[Blue 5]] is protecting the Freighter but has had a shield failure.
segment.target: A翼[[藍隊 5 號]]正在保護貨船，但其護盾發生了故障。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will jump immediately to [[Habassa IV]] to relieve A-wing [[Blue 5]].
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將立即跳躍至[[哈巴薩四號（Habassa IV）]]接替A翼[[藍隊 5 號]]。

segment.source: B-wings continue to be deployed as rapidly as possible. The new fighters are proving themselves well suited to the roles they were designed for. Nevertheless, some weaknesses have come to light. They have proven to be especially vulnerable to TIE Interceptors.$ This requires that the B-wings have adequate escort when attacking a target defended by TIE Interceptors.
segment.target: B翼戰機正以最快速度持續部署到前線。這款新戰機充分證明非常契合其設計定位。然而，也暴露出若干弱點，特別是面對鈦式截擊機時較為脆弱。$ 這意味著當B翼戰機攻擊有鈦式截擊機防守的目標時，必須配備充分的戰機護航。

segment.source: All enemy starfighters launch in one minute intervals. You must kill them quickly to keep from being overwhelmed. Remember to give your wingman specific attack orders. (A Top Ace A-wing is very effective against T/Bs and T/Fs!)$ Use your missiles on any T/Bs (or other ships) that get by you. Have your wingman attack the T/Is if they prove troublesome.
segment.target: 所有敵方戰機每隔一分鐘發射一波。你必須迅速消滅它們，以防遭到火力淹沒。記住給僚機下達明確的攻擊指令。（王牌級A翼在對付鈦式轟炸機與鈦戰機時非常高效！）$ 對任何溜過防線的轟炸機（或其他艦船）使用飛彈。若攔截機難以對付，可命令僚機進行圍攻。

segment.target: 凱瑟琳號呼叫A翼紅隊，感謝你們保護拉德利號

segment.source: WE'LL GET THESE B-WINGS ON LINE ASAP!
segment.target: 我們將儘快讓這批B翼戰機進入作戰狀態！

segment.source: MEANWHILE, Y-W GOLD WILL HELP YOU WITH THAT FRIGATE
segment.target: 與此同時，Y翼金隊將協助你們對付那艘巡防艦

segment.source: Help lure an Imperial Frigate into a trap so it may be captured.
segment.target: 協助將帝國巡防艦 誘入陷阱， 以便實施 登艦俘獲。
>第 14A 號作戰：誘捕帝國巡防艦

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] will rendezvous with two Corvettes at Nav Buoy 1A-7/Q.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]將在導航浮標 1A-7/Q 處與兩艘巡邏艦會合。

segment.source: The Corvettes' meeting has been leaked to the Empire as bait.
segment.target: 巡邏艦的會合情報已作為誘餌故意洩漏給帝國。

segment.source: The Imperial Frigate [[Mayhem]] is expected to respond.
segment.target: 預計帝國巡防艦[[混亂號（Mayhem）]]將前來攔截。

segment.source: [[Blue]] Squadron will attack with several waves of B-wings to disable it.
segment.target: [[藍隊]]中隊將以數波B翼戰機展開進攻並將其癱瘓。

segment.source: Once disabled, Transports will deliver Commandos to capture the Frigate.
segment.target: 一旦癱瘓，運輸艦將運送特戰突擊隊登艦俘獲該艦。

segment.source: X-wing[[ Red]] must protect the Transports from enemy action.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]必須保護運輸艦免受敵軍打擊。

segment.source: The Star Destroyer [[Relentless's]] task force of Frigates and System Patrol Squadrons has suffered tremendous losses but remains strong and determined. So far the Imperials' deployments have worked to our advantage allowing us to slowly defeat them in detail.$ What we need is a definitive picture of the current strength and disposition of the task force. Our next operation will supply this.
segment.target: 滅星者[[殘酷號（Relentless）]]的巡防艦與巡邏中隊特遣艦隊遭受了沉重打擊，但依然強大且意志堅決。到目前為止，帝國的分散部署反而對我們有利，讓我們得以逐步各個擊破。$ 我們現在需要的是一份關於該特遣隊目前兵力與部署的確切情報。我們接下來的行動將提供這一關鍵訊息。

segment.source: We have a rendezvous planned with an [[Habassan]] Corvette bearing top secret information regarding candidate base locations. Details of the rendezvous were "leaked" to a known Imperial spy.$ The only Imperial capital ship that can respond is the Frigate [[Mayhem]]. With this meeting as bait we are sure to lure the [[Mayhem]] into our trap. There we intend to capture it.
segment.target: 我們計畫與一艘載有候選基地機密情報的[[哈巴薩]]巡邏艦會合。這次會晤的細節已被故意『洩漏』給一名已知的帝國間諜。$ 唯一能及時趕到的帝國主力艦就是巡防艦[[混亂號]]。以這次會晤作為誘餌，我們必定能將[[混亂號]]誘入我們的陷阱，並將其完整俘獲。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will send two X-wings to the rendezvous to stop any attack on the Corvettes. The Corvettes will leave soon after the [[Mayhem]] arrives. Any TIE Interceptors must be destroyed so B-wing [[Blue]] can make their attack runs unimpeded.$ Once the B-wings have disabled the Frigate, Transports will deliver commando teams to board and capture it. This ship must be recovered intact!
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊將派出兩架X翼戰機前往會合點阻截對巡邏艦的攻擊。巡邏艦將在[[混亂號]]抵達後不久脫離。任何鈦式截擊機都必須消滅，以確保B翼[[藍隊]]的攻擊航路暢通無阻。$ 一旦B翼戰機癱瘓巡防艦，運輸艦將送突擊隊登艦俘獲。這艘戰艦必須完整奪取！

segment.source: Intercept and destroy T/Bs until the CRVs leave, then go after the T/Is. Keep them away from the B-Ws.$ Stay close to the Mayhem to draw its fire away from the B-Ws. (Watch for the FRG's shields to go down, then order the 1st B-Ws home.)$ GUN Mu (1 wave) enters when the FRG is disabled. These target TRN Storm 1 and must be intercepted. You may need to use torps. GUN Tau (3 waves) enters when it is captured.
segment.target: 攔截並摧毀鈦式轟炸機直至巡邏艦撤離，然後全力追擊鈦式截擊機。讓敵機遠離B翼戰機。$ 貼近混亂號飛行以吸引其防空火力遠離B翼戰機。（注意當巡防艦護盾失效時，命令第 1 批B翼戰機返航。）$ 突擊砲艇繆隊（1 波）將在巡防艦被癱瘓時進場。它們的目標是風暴 1 號運輸艦，必須予以攔截。你可能需要使用魚雷。突擊砲艇陶隊（3 波）將在巡防艦被俘獲時進場。

segment.source: THE SURVIVING CREW AND OFFICERS WILL BE INTERROGATED
segment.target: 倖存的船員與軍官將接受審訊

segment.source: Intercept Imperial troop convoy and identify which craft are carrying officers. Disable the officer's ship so it may be captured.
segment.target: 攔截帝國部隊船隊， 辨識載有軍官的艦船。 將其癱瘓 以便俘獲審訊。
>第 14B 號作戰：俘獲帝國軍官

segment.source: A convoy of Troop Transports is to rendezvous with the Frigate [[Mayhem]].
segment.target: 一隊部隊運輸艦船隊即將與巡防艦[[混亂號（Mayhem）]]會合。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will intercept each ship and identify the passengers.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將攔截每一艘艦船並辨識艦上乘員。

segment.source: There will be at least one carrying officers. This is to be disabled.
segment.target: 其中至少有一艘載有帝國軍官，必須將其癱瘓。

segment.source: Once disabled, a commando Transport will arrive to capture the officers.
segment.target: 一旦癱瘓，突擊隊運輸艦將抵達並俘獲軍官。

segment.source: The rest of the convoy is to be destroyed.
segment.target: 船隊的其餘艦船必須全部摧毀。

segment.source: The Mayhem will arrive less than ten minutes after you, so move quickly!
segment.target: 混亂號將在你們抵達不到十分鐘後進場，行動務必迅速！

segment.source: The Star Destroyer [[Relentless's]] task force of Frigates and System Patrol Squadrons has suffered tremendous losses. We remain in great danger, however, as we still do not have a clear picture of exactly what we are facing.$ Our intelligence gathering operations just aren't giving us enough information. It has been decided to attempt the capture of some Imperial officers for interrogation.
segment.target: 滅星者[[殘酷號（Relentless）]]的特遣艦隊遭受了慘重損失。然而我們依然處於巨大危險之中，因為我們對敵人的全貌仍然缺乏精確了解。$ 我們的情報蒐集管道無法提供足夠的深層情報。因此決定俘獲若干帝國軍官以進行審訊。

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS$>FOR COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>任務已備妥$>過關詳細戰略與戰術建議。$$$>若你想親自探索難題，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點選黑色頁碼框$>即可查看提示內容。

segment.source: We have solid information regarding a convoy of Imperial Troop Transports that are to rendezvous with the Frigate [[Mayhem]]. There will be a brief window of opportunity wherein we may be able to capture the officers' Transport.$ [[Red ]]Squadron will send two B-wings to intercept the convoy. [[Red Two]] will identify and disable the officer's ship. A Commando unit will then arrive to capture the Imperial officers.
segment.target: 我們掌握了關於一隊帝國部隊運輸艦正準備與巡防艦[[混亂號]]會合的確切情報。這將為我們創造一個稍縱即逝的機會，讓我們能俘獲軍官座艦。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣兩架B翼戰機攔截船隊。[[紅二號]]將辨識並癱瘓軍官的座艦。特戰小隊隨後登艦俘獲帝國軍官。

segment.source: Set recharge rates to full to match speed with the TRNs, shields to normal to close. Target, ID, then destroy the TRNs one at a time.$ Destroy all other TRNs before disabling officer's TRN. IDing officers causes GUNs to enter, order your wingman to attack them.$>SPOILER!$ [[ Press 'Y' at mission start and assign to memory. This is the officer's TRN.]]
segment.target: 將充能速率調至最高以匹配運輸艦的速度，護盾調至正常以接近。鎖定、辨識，然後一次摧毀一艘運輸艦。$ 在癱瘓軍官運輸艦前先摧毀所有其他運輸艦。辨識軍官會引來突擊砲艇，命令僚機攻擊它們。$>劇透提示！$ [[ 任務開始時按『Y』鍵並存入記憶，這就是軍官的運輸艦。]]

segment.source: THE IMPERIAL OFFICERS HAVE BEEN CAPTURED
segment.target: 帝國軍官已被成功俘獲

segment.source: THEY WILL BE INTERROGATED ABOUT THE RELENTLESS'S TASK FORCE
segment.target: 他們將針對殘酷號特遣隊的機密接受審訊
極其出色的任務表現，紅二號！

segment.source: Escort B-wings as they attempt to destroy the last Frigate in the Star Destroyer Relentless's task force.
segment.target: 護航B翼戰機， 摧毀滅星者殘酷號 特遣隊中的 最後一艘巡防艦。
>第 15 號作戰：護航B翼戰機進攻

segment.source: The Imperial Frigate [[Juvaini]] is vulnerable as it completes repairs.
segment.target: 帝國巡防艦[[朱瓦尼號（Juvaini）]]正在維修，防禦脆弱。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will escort B-wing [[Blue]] in an attack to destroy this Frigate.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將護航B翼[[藍隊]]發起突擊摧毀該巡防艦。

segment.source: B-wing [[Blue]] will attack the Frigate in two waves.
segment.target: B翼[[藍隊]]將分兩波攻擊巡防艦。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will eliminate the TIE Fighter defensive patrols.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將消滅防守的鈦戰機巡邏隊。

segment.source: Interrogation of the captured Imperial officers has revealed that the Star Destroyer [[Relentless]] is even more vulnerable than we had hoped! Our victories have resulted in the Frigate division of the task force being reduced to a single ship.$ It is the [[Juvaini]], currently being serviced near [[Sunaj IV]]. This was one of the Frigates that attacked the Alliance Cruiser [[Maria]] when she was receiving [[Blue]] Squadron's B-wings.$
segment.target: 對俘獲的帝國軍官進行審訊後發現，滅星者[[殘酷號（Relentless）]]比我們預想的還要脆弱！我們的連續勝利已讓其巡防艦編隊縮減至僅剩最後一艘。$ 這就是巡防艦[[朱瓦尼號]]，目前正在[[蘇納吉四號（Sunaj IV）]]附近進行整修維護。這艘戰艦正是當初攻擊巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號]]接收B翼戰機的元兇之一。$

segment.source: Fittingly, [[Blue]] Squadron has been chosen to lead the attack. Six B-wings will attack in two waves of three ships each.$ The [[Juvaini]] will be protected by its two squadrons of TIE Fighters. [[Red]] Squadron will provide two A-wings for escort and support. A-wing [[Red]] is to neutralize the enemy fighters until the Frigate is destroyed. Help [[Blue]] Squadron get their revenge!
segment.target: 順理成章地，[[藍隊]]中隊被選為帶頭主攻的部隊。六架B翼將分成兩波、每波三架發動突擊。$ [[朱瓦尼號]]由其搭載的兩個中隊鈦戰機防衛。[[紅隊]]中隊將提供兩架A翼進行護航與掩護。A翼[[紅隊]]負責壓制敵方戰機直到巡防艦被摧毀。協助[[藍隊]]中隊完成這場復仇之戰！

segment.source: Target the nearest enemy and engage. There are two squadrons to be defeated, one of T/Fs and one of T/Is.$ You only have 6 missiles, so save them for the GUNs that arrive 2.5 minutes after the attack on the Juvaini begins.$ Keep an eye on the FRG. When its hull is damaged, switch to single fire mode and attack it. (This is the best way to "get the kill!")
segment.target: 鎖定最近的敵軍並交火。必須擊潰兩個中隊，一個鈦戰機（T/F）中隊與一個鈦式截擊機（T/I）中隊。$ 你只有 6 枚飛彈，把它們留給在對朱瓦尼號發起進攻 2.5 分鐘後進場的突擊砲艇。$ 隨時注意巡防艦的狀況。當其艦體受損時，切換至單發模式對其射擊（這是搶下擊殺戰果的最佳方式！）。

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS$>FOR COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>任務已備妥$>過關詳細戰略與戰術建議。$$$>若你想親自探索難題，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點選黑色頁碼框$>即可查看提示內容。
朱瓦尼號已被徹底摧毀！

segment.source: NOW WE CAN PREPARE TO STRIKE THE RELENTLESS!
segment.target: 現在我們可以全力準備進攻殘酷號了！

segment.source: Lead an assault on the Empire's Probe Calibration Site.
segment.target: 率領突擊隊， 進攻帝國的 探測器校準基地。
>第 16 號作戰：突擊探測器校準基地

segment.source: [[Relentless]] is conducting calibration tests on new surveillance probes.
segment.target: [[殘酷號]]正在對新型偵察探測器進行校準測試。

segment.source: The Probes are arrayed between Containers full of test equipment.
segment.target: 探測器整齊排列在滿載測試設備的貨櫃之間。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will destroy all of the Probes and calibration equipment.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將摧毀所有探測器與校準設備。

segment.source: Watch for Gunboats and any fighters launched by the [[Relentless]].
segment.target: 提防突擊砲艇以及[[殘酷號]]起飛的所有戰機。

segment.source: As you know, the [[Habassa]] have provided us with data on a number of moons and planets which may be suitable for building a new main base. These are being carefully evaluated.$ Wherever we choose to go, we must first disentangle from the pursuing Imperial forces led by the Star Destroyer [[Relentless]]. The next series of missions will culminate in the destruction of the [[Relentless]].
segment.target: 如你所知，[[哈巴薩人]]已向我們提供了許多可能適合建立新基地的衛星與行星數據。我們目前正在進行審慎評估。$ 無論我們最終選擇何處，首先都必須徹底甩掉以滅星者[[殘酷號]]為首的帝國追擊部隊。接下來的一系列任務將以徹底摧毀[[殘酷號]]作為高潮結尾。

segment.source: The Empire seems to have realized finally that some of their probes have been supplying bogus data. A new series of probes is being specially calibrated by the [[Relentless]] and we have learned the location where this is being done.$ [[Red ]]Squadron will send three B-wings to attack the site. You will be responsible for destroying all of the probes and calibration equipment. Fade when done.
segment.target: 帝國似乎終於察覺到部分探測器正在回傳偽造情報。一系列全新探測器目前正由[[殘酷號]]進行特別校準，我們已獲悉該作業的地點。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣三架B翼戰機突襲該基地。你將負責摧毀所有探測器與校準設備。完成後跳躍脫離。

segment.source: Order your wingmen to attack one of the near group of CONs while you attack another. Use 3 torps. Repeat this procedure for the remaining pair of CONs, then target a far CON and order your wingmen to attack it.$ Destroy GUN Mu, then proceed toward the far CONs.$ Set cannons to full recharge and redirect minimum shield energy to the engines. Destroy Probes as you go.
segment.target: 命令僚機攻擊近處的一組貨櫃，你自己攻擊另一組。使用 3 枚魚雷。對剩餘的一對貨櫃重複此步驟，然後鎖定遠處的貨櫃並命令僚機攻擊。$ 摧毀突擊砲艇繆隊，然後向遠處的貨櫃前進。$ 將雷射調至最大充能，並將最小護盾能量重導至引擎。沿途摧毀所有探測器。

segment.source: THE PROBE CALIBRATION AREA HAS BEEN DESTROYED
segment.target: 探測器校準基地已被摧毀

segment.source: THE EXPANSION OF THE IMPERIAL SURVEILLANCE NETWORK IS DISRUPTED
segment.target: 帝國偵察網絡的擴張已被挫敗

segment.source: Ambush a convoy of Imperial Corvettes and neutral Freighters that will rendezvous with the Relentless.
segment.target: 伏擊一支由 帝國巡邏艦與中立運輸船 組成的船隊， 他們即將與 殘酷號會合。

segment.source: A convoy carrying replacement TIEs for the [[Relentless]] will be attacked.
segment.target: 一支運送[[殘酷號]]替換鈦戰機的船隊將遭到攻擊。

segment.source: They are being escorted by TIE Bombers as well as some Corvettes.
segment.target: 他們由鈦式轟炸機及數艘巡邏艦護航。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will initiate the attack. Three Alliance Corvettes will join in.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將發起攻擊。三艘同盟巡邏艦隨後加入。

segment.source: CRV [[Chip]] will arrive first, followed by CRV group [[Yogi]].
segment.target: 巡邏艦[[晶片號]]將率先抵達，隨後是巡邏艦[[瑜珈隊]]。

segment.source: All of the Corvettes and Freighters must be destroyed.
segment.target: 所有的巡邏艦與運輸船都必須摧毀。

segment.source: Following our successful raid on the Probe calibration site, we are preparing to attack the Star Destroyer [[Relentless]]. Before we can proceed we must ensure that it is as vulnerable as possible.$ Due to our earlier successes, the [[Relentless's]] starfighters have been all but wiped out. A convoy is even now rushing replacements to the Star Destroyer. Fortunately, we know the convoy's flight path!
segment.target: 在我們成功突襲探測器校準站後，我們正準備攻擊滅星者[[殘酷號]]。在展開行動前，我們必須確保它處於最脆弱的狀態。$ 由於我們先前的戰果，[[殘酷號]]的星際戰機幾乎被全殲。一支船隊正火速運送補充機隊前往該滅星者。幸運的是，我們掌握了該船隊的航線！

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS$>FOR COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>完成此任務的$>戰略與戰術建議$>現已提供。$$$>若你想親自探索，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點擊黑色頁碼方塊$>即可查看提示。

segment.source: Unfortunately, we have few resources to devote to the attack, and no time to adequately prepare! [[Red]] Squadron will scramble three A-wings immediately. They will be joined shortly by the Corvette [[Chip]]. Two more Corvettes from Group [[Yogi]] will arrive moments later. Additionally, three of Group [[Doile's]] Corvettes are en route, but may not arrive for another twenty minutes.$ This will be a tough one, good luck!
segment.target: 不幸的是，我們能投入這次攻擊的資源有限，且沒有時間充分準備！[[紅隊]]將立即緊急派出三架A翼。巡邏艦[[晶片號]]不久後將加入。來自[[瑜珈隊]]的另外兩艘巡邏艦隨後也會趕到。此外，[[多伊爾]]隊的三艘巡邏艦也在途中，但可能要二十分鐘後才會抵達。$ 這將是一場硬仗，祝好運！

segment.source: First power up shields and cannons. Then order wingmen to attack the T/Bs and (arriving) GUNs. Use your missiles if needed against the T/Bs.$ If you're having problems with the CRVs, kill them while the Alliance CRVs are attacking. This will draw off some fire from Alliance CRVs helping them to last longer. $ When the CRVs get to the mines and turn, time is running out. If so, ignore everything but them.
segment.target: 首先為護盾和雷射砲充能。接著命令僚機攻擊鈦式轟炸機與（隨後抵達的）突擊砲艇。對抗鈦式轟炸機時必要時可使用飛彈。$ 若你應對巡邏艦感到吃力，可以在同盟巡邏艦開火時協同擊毀敵艦。這能分擔同盟巡邏艦承受的火力，讓它們撐得更久。$ 當巡邏艦抵達水雷區並轉向時，代表時間所剩無幾。若出現此情況，請無視其他目標，專心對付它們。

segment.source: THIS WILL ENSURE THE RELENTLESS REMAINS VULNERABLE
segment.target: 這將確保殘酷號持續處於易受攻擊的狀態

segment.source: Stop the delivery of replacement TIE Interceptors to the Star Destroyer Relentess.
segment.target: 阻止向滅星者殘酷號 交付補充用的 鈦式截擊機。
>第 17B 作戰：阻止新型鈦戰機交付

segment.source: The[[ Relentless]] will rendezvous at [[Sunaj]] to receive replacement fighters.
segment.target: [[殘酷號]]將在[[蘇納吉]]會合，接收補充戰機。

segment.source: Freighters will be delivering Cargo Containers loaded with new TIE/Ints.
segment.target: 運輸船將運送裝滿全新鈦式截擊機的貨櫃。

segment.source: B-wing[[ Red ]]will fly a quick hit and fade to destroy these Containers.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將執行迅速的一擊脫離突襲以摧毀這些貨櫃。

segment.source: The [[Relentless]] still has an unknown number of TIE Fighters and Bombers.
segment.target: [[殘酷號]]仍擁有數量不明的鈦戰機與鈦式轟炸機。

segment.source: The good news is that, thanks to our skilled pilots, the Star Destroyer [[Relentless]] has suffered horrendous losses to its starfighter complement. The bad news is that they are being replaced with new TIE Interceptors.$ Fortunately, we have intercepted an Imperial transmission revealing where the [[Relentless]] is to rendezvous with the resupply ships. A quick hit and fade interdiction strike will have to be made immediately!
segment.target: 好消息是，多虧我們優秀的飛行員，滅星者[[殘酷號]]的星際戰機編制遭受了毀滅性打擊。壞消息是，他們正打算用全新的鈦式截擊機進行補充。$ 幸運的是，我們截獲了一則帝國通訊，揭示了[[殘酷號]]與補給船隊的會合地點。我們必須立即展開迅速的一擊脫離阻截突襲！

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will send two B-wings to execute this attack on the resupply ships. Destroy all Cargo Containers and withdraw. Avoid engaging enemy starfighters.$ The raid should take less than five minutes. If it is successful a follow up attack is planned to destroy the [[Relentless]]. The Imperial Navy will lose contact with our forces and we will have only surveillance probes between us and freedom!
segment.target: [[紅隊]]將派出兩架B翼對補給船隊執行此次攻擊。摧毀所有貨櫃後立即撤離，避免與敵方星際戰機交戰。$ 突襲行動應在五分鐘內完成。若行動成功，我們計劃發動後續攻擊以徹底摧毀[[殘酷號]]。帝國海軍將失去與我軍的接觸，而我們通往自由的道路上就只剩下偵察探測器了！

segment.source: Target the 1st CON and order your wingman to attack it. Then launch a torp at it yourself. As soon as your wingman fires (2) torps, target the next CON and proceed in similar fashion to destroy the rest.$ If and when your wingman dies, fire 3 torps at each remaining CON.
segment.target: 鎖定第一個貨櫃並命令僚機攻擊。接著自己也向其發射一枚魚雷。一旦僚機發射了（兩枚）魚雷，立即鎖定下一個貨櫃，並以類似方式摧毀其餘貨櫃。$ 如果僚機陣亡，請對每個剩餘貨櫃各發射 3 枚魚雷。

segment.source: THE RELENTLESS IS NOW VULNERABLE TO A DIRECT ATTACK!
segment.target: 殘酷號現在極易受到直接攻擊！

segment.source: Lead a direct assault on the Relentless. You will be responsible for knocking out the shield generators.
segment.target: 率領對殘酷號的 直接強襲。 你將負責 摧毀護盾發生器。

segment.source: The Star Destroyer [[Relentless]] will be finished off in this attack.
segment.target: 滅星者[[殘酷號]]將在這次攻擊中被徹底解決。

segment.source: It has minimal starfighter support but has been reinforced with Gunboats.
segment.target: 其星際戰機支援極少，但已獲得突擊砲艇的增援。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will lead the assault escorted by A-wing [[Gold]].
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]將在A翼[[金隊]]護航下帶頭強襲。

segment.source: B-wing [[Blue]] will join the attack two minutes later.
segment.target: B翼[[藍隊]]將在兩分鐘後加入攻擊。

segment.source: Thanks to the destruction of the TIE Interceptor replacements the [[Relentless]] is vulnerable to a follow up attack. Our plan is to finish it off and then destroy the remaining Imperial surveillance probes. This will allow the Alliance Fleet to escape to our new base unwatched.$ The Imperial Navy is depending on the constant flow of information from the [[Relentless]]. Without it they will lose contact with us.
segment.target: 多虧摧毀了其補充的鈦式截擊機，[[殘酷號]]現在極易受到後續打擊。我們的計劃是徹底消滅它，然後摧毀剩餘的帝國偵察探測器。這將使同盟艦隊能在不受監視的情況下逃往新基地。$ 帝國海軍全仰賴[[殘酷號]]持續傳送的情報。一旦失去它，他們將完全失去我們的行蹤。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will send two B-wings to lead the assault. [[Red One]] will be responsible for destroying the Star Destroyer's shield generators. You will have two A-wings from [[Gold]] Squadron for escort.$ Two minutes after B-wing [[Red]] drops out of hyperspace, the first of two waves of B-wings from [[Blue]] Squadron will arrive. If the [[Relentless's]] shields have been brought down this will be sufficient.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]將派出兩架B翼領銜強襲。[[紅隊一號]]將負責摧毀滅星者的護盾發生器。來自[[金隊]]的兩架A翼將為你護航。$ 在B翼[[紅隊]]脫離超空間兩分鐘後，來自[[藍隊]]的第一波兩架B翼將會抵達。如果[[殘酷號]]的護盾已被癱瘓，這股兵力就足以將其摧毀。

segment.source: Target the first CRV that arrives and fire 6 torps at it. Weave in toward the STD and fire 3 torps at each Shield Generator.$ Engage enemy starfighters to keep them away from B-W Blue.$ Stay near the STD and watch for its hull to get damaged. Break from whatever you're doing and attack the STD. Use your lasers in single-fire mode to maximize your chance of getting the "kill shot."
segment.target: 鎖定抵達的第一艘巡邏艦並向其發射 6 枚魚雷。穿插逼近滅星者，對每個護盾發生器各發射 3 枚魚雷。$ 與敵方戰機交戰，使其遠離B翼藍隊。$ 保持在滅星者附近，觀察其艦體何時受損。放下手頭一切工作轉向攻擊滅星者。將雷射設為單發模式，以最大化取得「擊殺一擊」的機會。

segment.source: WE ONLY HAVE TO DESTROY THE EMPIRE'S PROBES NOW
segment.target: 我們現在只需摧毀帝國的探測器了

segment.source: Do your part in an Alliance attempt to wipe out every Imperial surveillance probe in this sector.
segment.target: 在同盟企圖肅清 此星區內所有 帝國偵察探測器的 行動中克盡己責。

segment.source: These Probes are protected by small minefields.
segment.target: 這些探測器由小型水雷區保護。

segment.source: All Imperial Probes still in this sector are to be simultaneously destroyed.
segment.target: 仍在此星區的所有帝國探測器將同時被摧毀。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will detail a single B-wing to the destruction of this Probe.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]將指派一架B翼負責摧毀此探測器。

segment.source: The data provided by the [[Habassa]] has been evaluated. The sixth planet in the remote [[Hoth]] system has been chosen as the site for our new base. [[Hoth]] is a stormy, frozen world covered by snow and ice. Despite the harsh conditions it is habitable.$ Perhaps most important, the system was written off long ago as being almost totally worthless. It is unlikely that the Empire will look for us there!
segment.target: [[哈巴薩]]提供的資料已評估完畢。偏遠的[[霍斯]]星系中第六顆行星已被選定為我們新基地的所在地。[[霍斯]]是一個被冰雪覆蓋、暴風肆虐的酷寒世界。儘管環境嚴酷，但仍適宜居住。$ 或許最重要的是，該星系很久以前就被認定為幾乎毫無價值而被放棄。帝國絕不可能料到我們會躲在那裡！

segment.source: The Star Destroyer [[Relentless]] has been eliminated, depriving the Empire of the only task force to have remained in contact with our fleet. We must now act quickly to make good our escape.$ All that remains between our fleet and [[Hoth]] are the Imperial Probes scattered throughout this sector. Once these probes are eliminated our ships can safely jump to our new home.
segment.target: 滅星者[[殘酷號]]已被消滅，使帝國失去了唯一與我軍艦隊保持接觸的特遣部隊。我們現在必須迅速採取行動以順利撤離。$ 橫亙在我軍艦隊與[[霍斯]]之間的，只剩下散布在此星區的帝國探測器。一旦消滅這些探測器，我們的艦船便能安全跳躍前往新家園。

segment.source: Every Imperial Probe in this sector is to be attacked at once. This will require almost every starfighter in the Alliance fleet. [[Red One]] is assigned a B-wing to destroy the probe monitoring a Nav Buoy on our path.$ Time is of the essence. The faster these strikes are executed, the better are our chances of escaping undetected. Imperial reinforcements are imminent!
segment.target: 此星區內的每一具帝國探測器都將同時遭受攻擊。這將動用同盟艦隊幾乎所有的星際戰機。[[紅隊一號]]被指派駕駛一架B翼，摧毀監視我們航線上導航浮標的探測器。$ 時間至關重要。打擊行動執行得越快，我們在未被察覺下撤離的機率就越高。帝國援軍迫在眉睫！

segment.source: Press 'T' once to target the Probe and assign to memory.$ Reset recharge rates to maximum and transfer all cannon energy to the shields. Switch to torps and fire 2 at each of the 1st 3 GUNs you can target.$ Once enemy fighters are cleared make your attack run on the Probe.$>SPOILER!$ [[Destroy the CON and the FRTs and the CRVs will leave. Too simple?]]
segment.target: 按一次「T」鍵鎖定探測器並存入記憶槽。$ 將充能速率重新設為最大，並將所有艦砲能量轉移至護盾。切換至魚雷，對你能鎖定的前 3 架突擊砲艇各發射 2 枚魚雷。$ 一旦肅清敵機，立即對探測器展開俯衝攻擊。$>劇透！$ [[摧毀貨櫃與運輸船後巡邏艦便會撤退。太簡單了嗎？]]

segment.source: YOU HAVE DESTROYED THE IMPERIAL SURVEILLANCE PROBE
segment.target: 你已摧毀帝國偵察探測器
又是一次精彩的任務，紅隊一號！

segment.source: OUR MOMENT HAS ARRIVED, IT'S TIME TO MAKE OUR ESCAPE!
segment.target: 我們的時機到了，是時候撤離了！

segment.source: Help the last of the Alliance capital ships make the jump to Hoth unwatched by the Empire.
segment.target: 掩護最後一批 同盟主力艦在不被帝國 監視的情況下 跳躍前往霍斯。
>第 20A 作戰：拯救凱瑟琳號巡洋艦

segment.source: An Imperial Frigate has appeared and is launching an attack.
segment.target: 一艘帝國巡防艦現身並展開攻擊。

segment.source: The [[Cathleen]] is one of the last of our capital ships to jump to safety.
segment.target: [[凱瑟琳號]]是我們最後幾艘跳躍前往安全區域的主力艦之一。

segment.source: The [[Cathleen]] has launched her starfighters but could use some help.
segment.target: [[凱瑟琳號]]已派出其星際戰機，但仍需要支援。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will scramble all available B-wings to the [[Cathleen's]] aid.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]將緊急派出所有可用B翼前去支援[[凱瑟琳號]]。

segment.source: Operation "Blunt Stick" was an unqualified success. Most of the Alliance Fleet is now safely on its way to [[Hoth]]. Unfortunately, an Imperial Frigate has caught the Alliance Cruiser [[Cathleen]] on her way to her jump point.$ This Frigate must be destroyed before the [[Cathleen]] can make her jump. If it isn't, the Empire may determine the Cruiser's escape path and locate [[Hoth]].
segment.target: 「鈍木行動」取得了極大成功。大部分同盟艦隊現已安全啟程前往[[霍斯]]。不幸的是，一艘帝國巡防艦在同盟巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]前往跳躍點的途中截住了她。$ 在[[凱瑟琳號]]完成跳躍前，必須摧毀這艘巡防艦。否則，帝國可能會測算出巡洋艦的脫離航線並鎖定[[霍斯]]的位置。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron will scramble all available B-wings to the [[Cathleen's]] aid. Destroy the attacking Frigate and all of its TIE Fighters.$ More Imperial ships are undoubtedly on their way so be quick! The survival of the Alliance Fleet is in your hands!$$$>MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU!
segment.target: [[紅隊]]將緊急派出所有可用B翼前去支援[[凱瑟琳號]]。摧毀發動攻擊的巡防艦及其所有鈦戰機。$ 更多的帝國艦船無疑正在趕來途中，因此務必迅速！同盟艦隊的存亡掌握在你們手中！$$$>願原力與你同在！

segment.source: Don't worry about the FRG Dragon. Concentrate on the T/Bs, using your wingmen as often as possible. You may even collide with a torpedo or two that is heading for the CRS!$ When the CRVs appear, order any remaining wingmen to attack. Destroy the two middle CRVs first to weaken the other's field of fire.$ The TRNs that enter will launch torpedoes and also need to be stopped ASAP.
segment.target: 別擔心巨龍號巡防艦。集中精力對付鈦式轟炸機，並盡可能多呼叫僚機協助。你甚至可以直接撞毀一兩枚飛向巡洋艦的魚雷！$ 當巡邏艦出現時，命令剩餘的所有僚機發動攻擊。先摧毀中間的兩艘巡邏艦，以削弱對方的交火空域。$ 進場的運輸船會發射魚雷，同樣需要盡速制止。

segment.source: THE CRUISER CATHLEEN HAS MADE IT TO SAFETY
segment.target: 凱瑟琳號巡洋艦已抵達安全區域

segment.source: THE ALLIANCE FLEET IS SAFE FROM THE EMPIRE FOR NOW
segment.target: 同盟艦隊暫時脫離了帝國的威脅

segment.source: SEE YOU ON HOTH, RED ONE!
Help destroy Imperial Frigates so that the last Alliance Cruisers can escape to Hoth.
segment.target: 協助摧毀帝國巡防艦， 使最後一批同盟巡洋艦 能順利逃往霍斯。

segment.source: The Cruiser [[Yali]] awaits a rendezvous with the Cruiser [[Maria]].
segment.target: 巡洋艦[[雅麗號]]正等待與巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號]]會合。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red]] will join A-wing [[Gold]] in a defensive patrol while the [[Yali]] waits.
segment.target: 在[[雅麗號]]等待期間，B翼[[紅隊]]將加入A翼[[金隊]]執行防禦巡邏。

segment.source: When the [[Maria]] arrives, you will all proceed to [[Hoth]].
segment.target: 當[[瑪麗亞號]]抵達後，大家將一同啟程前往[[霍斯]]。

segment.source: The [[Maria]] should arrive five minutes after B-wing [[Red]] does.
segment.target: [[瑪麗亞號]]應在B翼[[紅隊]]抵達五分鐘後趕到。

segment.source: With the success of Operation "Blunt Stick", the Alliance Fleet can now escape safely to [[Hoth]]. Most of the Fleet is already on its way, and the advance party has already begun to establish a base there.$ The tension is very high as the last elements of our fleet prepare to make their hyperspace jumps. If any Imperial ships chance upon ours as they are leaving, the Empire may be able to determine the destination!
segment.target: 隨著「鈍木行動」圓滿成功，同盟艦隊現在可以安全撤往[[霍斯]]。大部分艦隊已經啟程，先遣部隊也已開始在那裡建立基地。$ 在我們艦隊最後一批人員準備進行超空間跳躍時，氣氛格外緊張。如果任何帝國艦船在撤離時碰巧撞見我們，帝國就可能藉此推斷出目的地！

segment.source: The Cruiser [[Yali]] is awaiting a rendezvous with the Cruiser [[Maria]]. Both ships will then jump together to [[Hoth]]. The [[Maria]] is en route and [[Red]] Squadron has been asked to send some additional starfighters to help patrol the rendezvous location.$ Any Imperial ships that happen into the area must be destroyed!$$>Happy hunting!$>MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU!
segment.target: 巡洋艦[[雅麗號]]正等待與巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號]]會合。兩艦隨後將一同跳躍前往[[霍斯]]。[[瑪麗亞號]]正在途中，[[紅隊]]已被要求派遣增援星際戰機協助巡邏會合空域。$ 任何闖入該區域的帝國艦船都必須予以摧毀！$$>祝狩獵順利！$>願原力與你同在！

segment.source: Target the 1st FRG that arrives and order your wingman to attack. Fire all of your torps and keep after it until it is destroyed.$ Whenever your wingman fires a salvo of torpedoes, order him to attack the 2nd FRG, then back again.$ Destruction of the 2nd FRG brings in a 4th, but the Maria will be there to help so don't worry.$ Don't forget to go for the "kill shots!"
segment.target: 鎖定抵達的第 1 艘巡防艦並命令僚機攻擊。發射你所有的魚雷並持續追擊直到將其摧毀。$ 每當僚機發射一輪齊射魚雷後，命令他轉向攻擊第 2 艘巡防艦，然後再轉回來。$ 摧毀第 2 艘巡防艦會引來第 4 艘，但瑪麗亞號會前來支援，所以不必驚慌。$ 別忘了爭取「擊殺一擊」！

segment.source: ANOTHER SPECTACULAR VICTORY FOR THE ALLIANCE!
segment.target: 同盟的又一次輝煌勝利！

segment.source: WELL, LET'S GET TO HOTH AND JOIN THE CELEBRATION!
segment.target: 好了，讓我們前往霍斯參加慶祝吧！
